jobs.title: Sales Recruiter
jobs.description_text: Hiring sales folks is just as tough (and important) as hiring engineers, yet tech recruiters get all the glory! There’s no code to review so you have to be super analytical to cut through the noise. Your hiring managers tend to be the ones most likely to go rogue on your process so you’ve got to know how to manage across and up. And then when it comes time to close, your candidates all want to negotiate. Everything. So you need to be part hostage negotiator. If this sounds like a typical Monday to you and you’re ready to bring your skills to a startup that will respect and value them, read on. We are now looking for a great startup recruiter to drive the next phase of our growth here in San Francisco. In this highly consultative role, you will truly partner with the business, working side by side with our VP of Sales to find and hire the best possible folks for our Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams. You’ll own the hiring process from role kickoff to offer negotiation while working with the Head of Talent to continuously iterate and optimize our process, tools, and candidate experience.

jobs.description_text: As our Assistant Project Manager, you will support the planning, coordination, and execution of commercial construction projects from preconstruction through closeout. Day‑to‑day, you will assist with submittals, RFIs, procurement, schedule updates, cost tracking, meeting documentation, and coordination between office and field teams. You will support communication with architects, engineers, subcontractors, and inspectors, helping maintain organized project records and ensuring timely responses to project needs. Experienced team members may assume increased ownership of specific scopes of work, lead subcontractor and vendor coordination, support preconstruction planning and buyout, assist with change management and forecasting, and contribute to continuous improvement in project delivery and overall team performance. Successful team members in this role are detail‑oriented, organized, and proactive communicators who support efficient, high-quality, and well-coordinated project execution.

Day‑to‑day, you will help coordinate subcontractor activities, monitor work‑in‑place, support short‑term planning and scheduling, and assist with site logistics, inspections, and material deliveries. jobs.title: Construction Manager / Owner's Representative
jobs.description_text: As our Project Manager (Construction Manager / Owner’s Representative), you will represent both the general contractor and the project owner throughout all phases of commercial construction. In this role, you will oversee project planning, coordination, contract compliance, budget and schedule performance, and risk management, ensuring that projects are executed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with owner expectations. You will work closely with owners, design teams, project managers, superintendents, and trade partners to facilitate communication, resolve issues, and maintain a clear line of sight to project goals. You will support decision‑making, monitor field progress, champion quality standards, and ensure that all deliverables, documentation, and technical requirements are met. Experienced Project Managers may lead multiple projects, guide preconstruction efforts, support contract negotiations, mentor project teams, and contribute to continuous improvement in project delivery and client satisfaction. Successful team members in this role are organized, proactive, communicative, and committed to representing the owner’s interests while facilitating smooth, well‑coordinated project execution.

jobs.title: Construction Project Safety Assistant
jobs.description_text: As our Project Safety Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting field safety efforts across our construction projects. You will assist project teams with daily inspections, documentation, training support, and hazard‑prevention activities to help maintain safe, well‑organized, and compliant job sites. You will work closely with superintendents, project managers, trade partners, and field crews to identify hazards, support corrective actions, maintain safety records, and reinforce company and OSHA requirements. This role is hands‑on and field‑focused, requiring strong communication, attention to detail, and a proactive mindset in dynamic construction environments. Experienced Project Safety Assistants may take on greater responsibility in conducting safety talks, leading portions of site orientations, aiding incident investigations, and contributing to continuous improvement in project safety culture. Successful team members in this role are observant, dependable, eager to learn, and committed to promoting a safe and productive jobsite for everyone involved.

jobs.title: Facilities Technician
jobs.description_text: As our Facilities Technician, you will play a key role in delivering high‑quality and safe construction projects by supporting fast‑paced, detail‑focused field operations. In this role, you will demonstrate strong craftsmanship, adaptability, and effective coordination with project teams across a wide range of specialized commercial construction, maintenance, renovation/repair and light expansion projects. You will perform a variety of carpentry and building tasks including light framing, installation of interior and exterior finishes, selective demolition, door and hardware installation, and general facility improvements. You will also help ensure that all work aligns with project plans, schedule, and quality standards while maintaining a clean, hazard‑free job site. Experienced technicians may take on more complex scopes, interact directly with clients, provide field‑driven solutions to the budget and scope of work, and support continuous improvement in project execution. Successful technicians in this role are committed to safety, craftsmanship, teamwork, customer service, and delivering excellent results in a dynamic construction environment.

You will oversee daily construction activities across various scopes of work, working closely with superintendents, project managers, and trade foremen to maintain schedule, productivity, and quality. You will also ensure that all work aligns with project plans, specifications, and safety standards while fostering a safe, efficient, and organized jobsite. Experienced General Foremen take ownership of complex project areas, manage multiple foremen and crews, resolve field challenges, and drive continuous improvement in planning, communication, and execution. Successful foremen in this role are strong leaders who are committed to safety, teamwork, accountability, and delivering outstanding results in a fast‑paced construction environment.

jobs.title: M.E.P. Coordinator - Building Commissioning
jobs.description_text: As our MEP Coordinator, you will lead the delivery of high‑quality commercial construction projects by supporting the planning, coordination, and commissioning of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and low‑voltage systems. In this role, you will ensure that building systems operate as intended by managing compliance requirements, supporting building automation integration, and overseeing testing, startup, and closeout activities across fast‑paced project environments. You will collaborate closely with project managers, superintendents, subcontractors, and design teams to ensure that all MEP work aligns with project drawings, specifications, commissioning plans, and owner requirements. You will also support the documentation, verification, and turnover processes necessary for high‑functioning and fully compliant building systems. Experienced coordinators may take on more complex systems integration responsibilities, lead commissioning meetings, work directly with owners and facility teams, assist in resolving field‑driven MEP challenges, and support continuous improvement in project execution. Successful team members in this role are committed to accuracy, system performance, safety, problem‑solving, and delivering excellent results throughout construction and commissioning.

jobs.title: Preconstruction Estimator
jobs.description_text: As our Estimator, you will perform accurate, competitive, and well‑coordinated project proposals across a wide range of construction projects. In this role, you will prepare detailed quantity takeoffs, analyze drawings and specifications, develop cost estimates, and collaborate closely with project managers, preconstruction teams, and trade partners to ensure the accuracy and completeness of all bids. You will help drive the planning and pricing strategy for upcoming work by identifying risks, evaluating constructability, validating scope, and supporting value‑engineering efforts. You will also assist with bid reviews, subcontractor outreach, and estimating documentation to support strong transitions from preconstruction into field execution. Experienced estimators may lead full project estimates, manage conceptual and schematic pricing exercises, mentor junior estimators, and play a strategic role in improving estimating processes and cost data. Successful estimators in this role demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail, technical competence, and a commitment to delivering high‑quality work in a deadline‑driven environment.

jobs.description_text: As our Preconstruction Manager, you will lead the planning, estimating, budgeting, and coordination efforts that set construction projects up for success. In this role, you will manage project estimates, cost modeling, value engineering, subcontractor outreach, bid packaging, constructability reviews, and preconstruction schedules to ensure projects are aligned with client goals, budgets, and timelines. You will work closely with owners, architects, engineers, business development teams, and operations personnel to develop project strategies, evaluate design and cost impacts, identify risks and opportunities, and provide accurate budgeting throughout the design process. You will oversee procurement planning, scope development, market analysis, and subcontractor engagement while maintaining clear communication with all stakeholders. Experienced preconstruction managers may lead multiple pursuits simultaneously, mentor estimators and preconstruction staff, participate in client presentations, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across estimating, planning, and project delivery processes. Successful preconstruction managers in this role excel at collaboration, analytical thinking, and proactive problem-solving while maintaining a clear focus on budget accuracy, risk mitigation, constructability, and client satisfaction.

jobs.title: Project Executive
jobs.description_text: As Project Executive, you will provide overall leadership and accountability for construction projects from preconstruction through closeout, ensuring successful delivery across all phases. You are responsible for project performance, including financial outcomes, schedule adherence, risk management, and client satisfaction, while building and leading high-performing teams. You will collaborate closely with owners, senior leadership, preconstruction, and operations to establish project strategy and drive execution. This includes proactively identifying and resolving project, contractual, and operational challenges while maintaining strong, professional relationships with clients, design teams, and trade partners. You will lead and mentor Project Managers and Superintendents, guide procurement and subcontractor buyout strategies, and lead preconstruction efforts, including budgeting, value engineering, scheduling, safety, and risk planning. Successful Project Executives are strategic, decisive leaders who consistently deliver predictable project outcomes, achieve financial targets, and exceed client expectations.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description_text: As our Project Manager, you will lead the day‑to‑day operational and administrative execution of commercial construction projects, ensuring efficient delivery from start to finish. In this role, you will manage project planning, cost control, scheduling, procurement, change management, and coordination across the project team and all trade partners. You will work closely with superintendents, owners, design teams, and subcontractors to maintain alignment on project goals, resolve field and design challenges, and ensure all work complies with contracts, drawings, and specifications. You will oversee documentation, budgets, risk mitigation, and communication to keep the project progressing on time and within scope. Experienced project managers may lead multiple phases of a project, mentor assistant project managers, support preconstruction activities, and contribute to continuous improvement in project delivery. Successful project managers in this role excel at communication, coordination, and proactive problem‑solving while maintaining a clear focus on schedule, cost, quality, and client satisfaction.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Civil Construction
jobs.description_text: As a Civil Construction Project Manager, you are responsible for leading infrastructure and site development projects from preconstruction through closeout, ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant delivery. You provide overall project leadership by aligning field operations, subcontractors, engineers, and owners around shared goals for schedule, cost, quality, and performance. On a day‑to‑day basis, you manage the critical mechanics of project execution, including cost tracking and forecasting, schedule updates, subcontractor coordination, material and equipment procurement, RFIs and submittals, change management, and documentation. You work closely with superintendents and field teams to address site conditions, sequencing challenges, utility conflicts, and production impacts while ensuring compliance with plans, specifications, permits, and inspection requirements. Experienced Project Managers take on expanded responsibility by leading multiple phases or scopes of work, mentoring Assistant Project Managers and Project Engineers, supporting estimating and preconstruction activities, and managing more complex risk, cost, and schedule challenges. They contribute to improving project delivery processes, strengthening client relationships, and driving lessons‑learned initiatives across the organization. Successful team members in this role excel at clear communication, disciplined cost and schedule control, and practical, solutions‑driven problem‑solving.

jobs.title: Quality Control Manager
jobs.description_text: As our Quality Control Manager, you will lead the planning, implementation, and enforcement of quality standards across construction projects, ensuring all work meets contract requirements, drawings, specifications, and applicable codes. In this role, you are responsible for driving consistent quality execution in the field while supporting project teams from preconstruction through closeout. You will work closely with project teams and trade partners to develop project‑specific quality plans, conduct inspections, and identify and resolve quality issues before they impact schedule or cost. This role includes reviewing submittals, monitoring installation methods, verifying compliance with project requirements, overseeing corrective actions, and managing quality documentation such as inspections, testing reports, punch lists, and closeout materials. Successful Quality Control Managers are detail‑oriented, field‑experienced, and effective communicators who balance enforcement with collaboration to deliver high‑quality projects and satisfied clients.

jobs.title: Superintendent
jobs.description_text: As our Superintendent, you will lead the day‑to‑day operations on active job sites to deliver safe, high‑quality projects on schedule. In this role, you will direct daily activities, coordinate subcontractors and suppliers, run site meetings, enforce safety and quality standards, and keep work moving efficiently in alignment with the project plan. You will collaborate closely with project managers, foremen, trade partners, and inspectors to ensure work complies with drawings, specifications, and applicable codes. You’ll maintain a clean, organized site; track progress; resolve field issues quickly; and communicate clearly with the project team to protect schedule, budget, and quality outcomes. Experienced superintendents may lead multiple phases, mentor assistant superintendents, contribute to look‑ahead planning, and support continuous improvement in field execution and safety culture. Successful superintendents in this role are hands‑on leaders who prioritize safety, coordination, communication, and proactive problem‑solving in a fast‑paced construction environment.

jobs.title: Surveyor Layout Technician
jobs.description_text: As our Surveyor - Layout Technician, you will play a critical role in ensuring construction projects are built accurately and efficiently. Your technical expertise, attention to detail, and commitment to quality will support successful project execution through precise layout, field verification, and coordination with project teams. In this role, you will work closely with superintendents, foremen, and project teams to support construction activities in the field. Your day-to-day activities may consist of establishing site control and benchmarks, operating survey equipment, performing layout for structures and utilities, collecting as-built information, verifying layout accuracy, troubleshooting field issues, maintaining survey data, coordinating with project leadership, and supporting equipment maintenance and team training. Successful team members in this role are dependable, safety-focused, and technically proficient. They are strong problem solvers who work well with others, communicate effectively, and take pride in delivering accurate, high-quality work.

jobs.title: Associate – Audiobook Licensing & Author Partnerships
jobs.description_text: The Audiobooks Mission is a team in the Product & Technology organisation focused on the ecosystem and strategies of Audiobooks on Spotify. We work across both the creator and consumer audiobooks ecosystems, in order to get the best possible product to market with the best possible content. Spotify's Audiobooks team is helping shape the future of audio storytelling by bringing the world's best audiobook experiences to millions of listeners. As Associate Manager, Audiobook Licensing & Author Partnerships, you'll play an important role in growing our catalog while building meaningful relationships across the independent publishing community. You'll work with entrepreneurial authors, hybrid publishers, independent presses, and distribution partners to identify great content, negotiate commercial partnerships, and help creators succeed on Spotify. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, and Finance, you'll help scale our audiobook business while creating exceptional experiences for both creators and listeners.

jobs.title: Director, Portfolio & Monetization Architecture
jobs.description_text: Spotify's growth depends on offering the right thing to the right listener at the right price, moving beyond one-size-fits-all packaging toward a portfolio where listeners can mix and match what they value most. The evolution of our subscription portfolio, and how we monetize it, is one of Spotify’s most important strategic opportunities in the years ahead. We’re looking for a Director to lead the strategic design of that portfolio end to end, shaping the architecture of tiers, add-ons, bundles, and the broader pricing ecosystem. This role will help define how the portfolio works today and how it evolves over the coming years to better serve listeners while driving sustainable growth. As the strategic engine behind our portfolio architecture, you’ll combine commercial intuition, consumer understanding, behavioral data, and real-world market signals to build conviction behind critical decisions. Working closely with cross-functional partners and senior leaders, you’ll help determine what belongs in Premium, what moves into new monetization layers, and how Spotify’s subscription offering continues to evolve for millions of listeners around the world.

jobs.title: Lead, Global Markets Strategy
jobs.description_text: The Lead, Global Markets Strategy is a role on the Global Markets Strategy (“GMS”) team, to be based in New York, reporting to the Director of Global Markets Strategy. This role is designed to have a strategic and analytical focus on our multi-year growth journey in our Markets.

jobs.title: Manager FP&A, Distribution Partnerships
jobs.description_text: Spotify is looking for a commercially minded FP&A Manager to serve as the dedicated finance partner for our Distribution Partnerships team. Distribution Partnerships play an important role in Spotify's growth strategy by working with strategic partners to expand user acquisition, deepen engagement, and improve retention through innovative distribution and marketing initiatives. In this role, you'll build the financial foundations that help shape partnership decisions. You'll develop robust business cases, subscriber models, and end-to-end P&L analyses that connect user growth with business outcomes. You'll partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate opportunities, challenge assumptions, and provide insights that help leaders make confident, data-informed decisions.

jobs.title: Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis – Payments & Customer Service
jobs.description_text: Spotify is looking for a Manager to join our Finance team and serve as a dedicated FP&A partner for our global Payments and Customer Service functions. As Spotify continues to scale across markets and monetization models, payments sit at the heart of how we acquire, convert, and retain subscribers, while customer service shapes the experience and cost of supporting them. This role owns the financial lens on both ecosystems. This is a high-impact, partner-facing finance role responsible for the payments and customer service forecast processes, the financial evaluation of payment partner and processor deals, the pipeline of payment optimization proposals, revenue protection and payment-cost assurance, and the modeling of contact center labor needs. You will partner with Payments, Customer Service, Subscriptions, Risk, Data, Financial Engineering, Accounting, and Business leadership to translate complex operational economics into clear financial narratives, build the models that inform decisions, and govern performance against plan.

jobs.title: Manager, Proposition Strategy
jobs.description_text: Spotify’s Propositions team is responsible for what we offer and how we package it — the plans, tiers, and propositions that shape how hundreds of millions of people experience and pay for Spotify. As Manager - Proposition Strategy, you’ll help define how Spotify grows its next billion users by developing affordable, locally relevant propositions, evolving existing tiers, and identifying new opportunities that can unlock sustainable growth. This is a role for someone who thinks in business cases as much as ideas. You’ll take work from an initial hypothesis through to an executive-ready recommendation — building the economics, assessing margin and licensing implications, modeling cannibalization risk, and creating a clear narrative for senior leaders. You’ll work closely with Strategy, Finance, Product, Legal, and Market teams, and your work will directly influence the propositions Spotify brings to some of the world’s fastest-growing markets.

jobs.title: Policy Support Specialist, Ads & Monetization Ops
jobs.description_text: Spotify Trust & Safety is dedicated to creating a platform that’s safe for users and creators and true to our values. We’re looking for a Policy Support Specialist to support our Ads & Monetization Operations. In this role, you’ll help strengthen our monetization policy enforcement operations across ad review and podcast monetization. You’ll partner with internal teams and vendors to resolve escalations, improve workflows, support policy and product updates, and strengthen training and quality programs.

jobs.title: Senior Editor, Podcast Editorial
jobs.description_text: Spotify is looking for a creative, strategic, and sharp editorial voice to join the US Podcast Editorial team. In this role, you'll lead high-visibility editorial projects end to end, partner cross-functionally as a creative and content expert, and shape how listeners discover and engage with podcasts and emerging formats on Spotify. The ideal candidate is a strong writer with a distinct editorial point of view who operates with independence and thrives at the intersection of creative judgment and platform strategy. This role reports into the Associate Director, Podcast Editorial & Audience Development.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel - Music Publishing
jobs.description_text: We are seeking an experienced Senior Legal Counsel with deep expertise in music publishing and copyright licensing to join our Legal Licensing Team. In this role, you will partner closely with Business Affairs, Finance, and Product teams to structure, negotiate, draft complex licensing agreements with CMOs, PROs, and music publishers, and advise on the legal frameworks governing the use of musical works across Spotify’s service.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Accountant, Advertising
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Revenue Accountant to join our global Revenue Accounting operations team supporting the Advertising Revenue segment, including Programmatic, Direct-Sold, Podcast, and Emerging Ad Products. This role sits within the Order-to-Cash (OTC) process and is responsible for driving accounting operations across Spotify's multi-billion dollar advertising business as it scales globally. The Revenue Accounting team is a central partner to Spotify's Advertising business, working at the intersection of Finance, Engineering, and Sales to ensure accurate financial reporting while building scalable processes that support rapid growth and new revenue streams. This role offers exposure to a wide range of cross-functional teams and strategic initiatives.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description_text: As the Controller, you will direct and control financial management and financial reporting, oversee the use and maintenance of accounting systems, and maintain internal controls. You will manage overall balance sheet management and oversee payroll, billing, accounts receivable, and accounts payable/expense reporting functions. You will also manage financial and federal audits and oversee corporate income tax reporting.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Delivery Lead
jobs.description_text: As the Senior Technical Delivery Lead, you will serve as the senior technology leader responsible for the successful delivery, operations, and continuous improvement of the technology and data-management capabilities supporting our clients. You will provide technical and delivery leadership across application, data, integration, reporting, infrastructure, and security functions to ensure the solution meets contractual, regulatory, operational, and business requirements. This is a senior individual-contributor leadership position and does not have direct people-management responsibilities. The role provides functional and technical direction across multidisciplinary teams and may provide oversight to technical resources. Individual in this role is expected to work at least 3 days per week in our West Des Moines or Chicago office This position does not provide visa sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants requiring sponsorship or temporary work authorization, including OPT or CPT, are not eligible for this position

jobs.title: Solution Delivery Manager
jobs.description_text: As the Solution Delivery Manager, you will lead one or more software engineering teams responsible for designing, building, testing, deploying, and supporting high-quality software products. You will combine technical leadership, people management, and delivery accountability to ensure engineering teams deliver reliable, scalable, and secure solutions aligned with business objectives. This Engineering Manager develops engineering talent, drives continuous improvement, partners closely with Product Management and Architecture, and fosters an engineering culture focused on ownership, innovation, quality, and customer value. Individual in this role is expected to work at least 3 days per week in our West Des Moines, Iowa office

jobs.title: Fulfillment Specialist
jobs.description_text: As a Fulfillment Specialist, your top priority is to get orders ready while upholding our high standards for quality, speed, and accuracy. You will also be responsible for advancing our warehouse processes by collaborating with other team members and actively contributing your ideas.

jobs.title: Hand Tool Technical Marketing Specialist
jobs.description_text: Do you deeply know hand tools and have the ability to describe them and their uses? In this role, your work is to know our tools, their applications and user communities, and the competitors’ lineups so you can help us improve our product lineup and make effective marketing content. You should have a minimum of 2,000 hours in hands-on experience using hand tools in a profession or for advanced personal projects. Some of the more relevant areas of tool use include: • Automotive, diesel, aviation, or small engine work and repair • Automation or robotics • Construction trades • Maintenance and assembly operations On top of tool expertise, you must be a creative, technical communicator. Web design, graphic design, photography, and other content-making skills are necessary either to have already or to learn rapidly at an advanced level. If you are looking for a more conventional marketing job that draws primarily on training in design, marketing, or journalism, this is not the role for you. In many cases, you will be the project leader responsible for developing the content that brings our tools to the market. You will need to fully understand real uses of our products and have the ability to visually communicate the features to our users across multiple forms of media such as photos, illustrations, charts/graphs, and videos.

jobs.title: Information Technology Specialist
jobs.description_text: As an Information Technology Specialist, you are proficient with technology, a skilled troubleshooter, and an excellent communicator. You will join the IT team to service a wide variety of technological needs across the company such as physical technical equipment, information systems, networking, and employee technology training and support. Much of your work will be reactive, and you will continue to learn more about technology and adapt to new situations every day. You will also need to connect well with other employees while maintaining a high level of accuracy and expertise in your work.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operator - CNC
jobs.description_text: As a Manufacturing Operator - CNC, you will produce Tekton tools with vertical and horizontal machining centers and Swiss-style machining centers. You will also interact with broaching machines, fiber marking lasers, automated sanding equipment, and a variety of small machines. You will work consistently, accurately, and quickly while following established procedures and meeting quality standards.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operator - Finishing
jobs.description_text: As a Manufacturing Operator - Finishing, you physically transform Tekton tools through the use of equipment such as vibratory polishing bowls, abrasive blasters, and an electroless nickel plating line. You must be able to do this work consistently, accurately, and quickly while following our established procedures and meeting quality standards.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operator - General
jobs.description_text: As a Manufacturing Operator - General, you physically transform our products through the use of a variety of equipment such as pneumatic and hydraulic presses, fiber marking lasers, and electric benders. You must be able to do this work consistently, accurately, and quickly while following our established procedures and meeting quality standards.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operator - Sewing
jobs.description_text: As a Manufacturing Operator - Sewing, you will produce fabric pouches and bags used to organize, carry, and store hand tools. This role spans the entire scope of making these products, from measuring and cutting materials to final sewn assembly. You must be able to work consistently, accurately, and quickly while following established specifications and meeting quality standards.

jobs.title: User Support Specialist
jobs.description_text: As a User Support Specialist, you will provide world-class support to end users so their entire experience with the Tekton brand is impressive.

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description_text: About AllSci AllSci is an AI-native platform designed for discovering, exploring, and publishing scientific knowledge. We are seeking a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Marketing Specialist to support the growth and visibility of AllSci within the scientific and academic community. This role will support the execution of marketing and communications initiatives, including content creation, social media management, campaign coordination, and outreach to the academic and scientific publishing community. The ideal candidate has direct experience working within an academic journal, scholarly publishing house, or research communications environment, and is comfortable leveraging AI tools to streamline content production and marketing workflows. Founded by MIT alumni and backed with over $40M in funding by leading investors in AI and robotics, Tutor combines human and artificial intelligence to build something greater than the sum of its parts — a Tutor Intelligence. As an AI software company that deploys its inventions directly into the facilities that need them, every line of code, process change, and decision at Tutor has a direct impact on the physical economy. The Role We're looking for a senior, technically credible, customer-oriented leader to own a portfolio of our most strategic enterprise customer sites running Tutor robots in production. You'll be the primary partner for each of your sites — the person their operations, engineering, and maintenance leaders trust when something matters — and you'll be accountable for the operational and technical success of those deployments over time. At the enterprise level, your portfolio will include some of our largest and most complex customers, often with multi-site footprints, sophisticated internal operations and engineering teams, and high expectations. This is not a traditional Customer Success role, and it's not a product engineering role either.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description_text: About zaimler AI agents can't reason over data they don't understand. Enterprise data today is fragmented across dozens of systems with no shared context, meaning, or structure, and that's why most enterprise AI is failing. The shift from copilots to autonomous agents is creating an entirely new infrastructure layer, and we're building it. zaimler is the context infrastructure for the agentic era: a platform that automatically discovers domain knowledge, maps relationships, and gives AI agents the semantic understanding to operate with precision at scale. Imagine knowledge graphs that support real-time inference, built for systems that need to reason, not just retrieve. zaimler was founded by Biswajit Das (ex-VP Engineering, Truera), a Data Infra veteran and former Chief Architect at Visa, and Sofus Macskassy (ex-Director of Engineering, LinkedIn), who built one of the largest knowledge graphs in production in the industry at LinkedIn. We're growing and deploying with major enterprises across insurance, travel, and technology. If you want to build infrastructure that the next decade of enterprise AI runs on, we'd love to talk. Why this role exists We’re hiring zaimler’s first Product Marketer to take us from 0 → 1 in GTM: define our narrative, package the product for a clear ICP, and own the company launch end-to-end in a B2B/enterprise market.
